teams.heading: Fiji deaf rugby sevens teams seek urgent funding for World Championship
teams.body: Fiji's men's and women's deaf rugby sevens teams require up to $70,000 to fund their campaign at the World Deaf Rugby Sevens Championship in Tokyo. Team manager Lionel Danford confirmed a significant shortfall remains for daily expenses and camp preparations, despite backing from the Fiji National Sports Commission and PacificAus Sports. Both squads entered camp last week and scheduled a scrimmage against Osea Kolinisau's national sevens team to refine technical skills.

lead.why: It is the only fresh, unreported rugby story in today's shortlist.

teams.heading: Emmanuel Iyogun reflects on converting to prop before earning England debut
teams.body: Northampton loosehead prop Emmanuel Iyogun has detailed his improbable transition from a reluctant front-row converter to an international test cap following his England debut against Argentina in July. Originally a No 8 and centre in Essex, the Spain-born forward switched positions at Northampton’s academy under Mark Hopley despite struggling initially in scrummaging drills. Iyogun, who replaced routine ball-carrying duties with front-row rucking work, earned his first cap off the bench during the summer tour.

teams.heading: France hold third place in Nations Championship after beating Japan 42-15
teams.body: France sit third in the inaugural Nations Championship table after securing two wins from their opening three fixtures, most recently defeating Japan 42-15 in Round 3. Fabien Galthié's squad have accumulated 116 points while conceding 75, giving Les Bleus a positive points difference of +41 in the 12-team standings. Every test match in the competition carries direct standing points towards determining the finalists later in the tournament calendar.

teams.heading: Connacht suffer URC defeat as Glasgow Warriors score four maul tries
teams.body: Connacht suffered a 36-19 United Rugby Championship defeat against Glasgow Warriors at Scotstoun on Friday night, extending a winless run away to the Scottish side stretching back to September 2010. Four of Glasgow's five tries came from dominant mauls, with Gregor Hiddleston crossing twice alongside scores from Rory Darge and Seb Stephen. Tries from Sean Jansen and a second-half double by Josh Ioane kept Connacht competitive, but yellow cards for Sam Illo and Josh Murphy proved costly for the visitors.

lead.why: Connacht's defeat to Glasgow Warriors in the URC provides the strongest match result in today's Irish rugby coverage.

teams.heading: Italy suffered a 32-14 defeat against South Africa in November 2025
teams.body: Italy lost 32-14 to South Africa in their most recent meeting, an international friendly hosted on home soil in November 2025. In the current Nations Championship, Gonzalo Quesada's side sit 11th in the 12-team standings after three rounds. Italy remain winless in the tournament, having recorded three defeats alongside 37 points scored and 131 conceded. That leaves the squad with a point differential of -94 following a 10-57 defeat against Australia in Round 3.

teams.heading: Former Scotland players face deadline to secure funding for concussion lawsuit
teams.body: No new court filings or formal responses have emerged regarding the ongoing concussion lawsuit involving former Scotland players following reports earlier this week of a £2.8 million legal fee demand. The case remains open but effectively stalled until claimants secure the required funding to proceed or reach an agreement on legal costs. Unless financial backing is finalised or the court issues a new procedural timeline, the action cannot move forward to a full hearing on liability.

teams.heading: Aaron Wainwright and Jac Morgan both score in Leicester victory over Gloucester
teams.body: Wales back-row Aaron Wainwright scored his first try for Leicester Tigers in a 38-31 Premiership victory over Gloucester. Wainwright completed 14 tackles alongside Tigers team-mate Tommy Reffell, who produced a vital try-saving tackle on Will Joseph and impressed at the breakdown. Jac Morgan also crossed early for Gloucester and set up another try with a powerful carry, while Olly Cracknell made 16 tackles for Leicester in a match featuring four Welsh standouts.

lead.why: Four Welsh internationals delivered prominent performances in Friday's Premiership clash between Leicester and Gloucester.

teams.heading: Mario Ledesma returns to Argentina as forwards coach under Felipe Contepomi
teams.body: Former head coach Mario Ledesma has rejoined the national set-up to lead the pack through to the 2027 World Cup. The legendary hooker, who stepped down from the top job in 2022, will work alongside new defence specialist Shaun Edwards in a revamped backroom team. "Mario and Shaun arrive at Los Pumas with enormous international experience," said head coach Felipe Contepomi. The duo will join the squad later this month before the upcoming tour of Ireland, Italy and France.

lead.why: The Shaun Edwards story was already reported today, so this leads with the significant simultaneous return of Mario Ledesma.

teams.heading: Japan men's sevens settle for bronze after shock semi-final loss to China
teams.body: Japan's men's sevens team claimed the bronze medal at the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya after suffering a 10-7 semi-final upset against China. The shock defeat ended the hosts' pursuit of gold, marking China's first appearance in an Asian Games final. Japan recovered to secure third place with a 17-5 victory over Korea, but the failure to reach the final highlights the increasing competitiveness of the regional circuit as Hong Kong China secured their third consecutive gold medal under head coach Jevon Groves.

lead.why: This is a major tournament result for the national side that serves as a necessary companion to the women's story already reported today.

teams.heading: New Zealand retain Bledisloe Cup after seven-try blitz overwhelms Australia
teams.body: New Zealand’s clinical finishing secured a 50-19 victory over Australia at Eden Park on Saturday to retain the Bledisloe Cup. Despite trailing early, the All Blacks responded with seven tries—including scores from Tupou Vaa’i and Peter Lakai—to extend their unbeaten streak at the Auckland venue to 54 matches. Dave Rennie, who noted that “no one wants to be part of the first team for a long time to lose at Eden Park,” saw his side end the Wallabies’ unbeaten run.

lead.why: The All Blacks secured a dominant 50-19 victory to retain the Bledisloe Cup today, extending their historic unbeaten run at Eden Park.

teams.heading: Steve Lancaster confirms no talks over Springbok return to Super Rugby
teams.body: New Zealand Rugby chief executive Steve Lancaster has confirmed there are no active discussions regarding a Springbok return to Super Rugby. Despite a "really tight" relationship between the two unions following the recent series, Lancaster noted that South Africa remains committed to the United Rugby Championship for the foreseeable future. The world champions, who currently sit top of the log, are described as "pretty bullish" about their northern-hemisphere alignment, citing burgeoning participation numbers and a strong domestic structure.

lead.why: New Zealand Rugby’s CEO clarifies the Springboks’ long-term commitment to northern-hemisphere competitions over a Super Rugby return.
